6ad300e2: ;
Enter values for fields in the DISPLAY TEXT file (#393)
.;
.;This code sets up variables and checks the environment to ensure
.;that it is ready to handle user input for fields in the file.
.;It also contains subroutines for various logic related to
.;validating and processing the user input.
1fafbea0: ;Call the DE subroutine to initialize variables, and begin the main logic.
9a6e8e99: ;Initialize variables related to the file and record being edited.
648fe8ac: ;If the DT field is defined, set the DE(1) node with the 5th piece (Date Signed).
3e781027: ;Clean up variables and quit.
e7d2c77f: ;Write the field label to the screen.
3fd42039: ;Simply quit this tag (used as a restart point).
ce191f1f: ;Call the W tag to display the field label, then write the current value of Y.
40203be7: ;If the data value is long and wordwrapping is allowed, go to the wordwrap routine.
3a45118f: ;If this is a no-edit field and DE(DQ) is defined, display '(No Editing)'.
4c6ffc5b: ;Read user input into X, set timeouts, allow exit with '^'.

514bbdf9: ;Branch to the tag defined by the value in DQ (used for branching logic).
6541d4e4: ;If DE(DQ) is defined, go to PR tag, otherwise display field and read input.

              ;else exit or re-prompt (based on DTIME).
8ba88d47: ;If X starts with '^', perform code contained in ^DIE17.
e4f4d019: ;If X is '@', branch to the ViewMan code contained in ^DIE2.

fa4b592b: ;If X is ' ' (space), and the DATA TYPE (DV) allows DATAO
               ;and the DD(DUZ DISPLAY for this field in this file exists,
               ;then use the DISPLAY value.

cf3d64d9: ;If a transform is defined, execute code.
               ;Else scan the multiple
               ;'|' pieces of DU for a match on X.
b7e13476: ;Loop through 'bar' pieces of DU looking for value to match X.
c99bc3eb: ;Get the final remaining piece of DU for output.

               ;gather 'pointer-screen' parameters into DIC
               ;then screen by D^DIC.

5f20d47e: ;For free text/numer DATA TYPEs,

               ;trailing 0s unless properly decimal.
